problem_title: Secure AI Agent Execution in Isolated Cloud Environments
problem_statement: AI agents can execute commands and manipulate files, but running untrusted operations directly on a user's computer creates security risks. TaskVault AI addresses this problem by executing approved tasks inside isolated Celesto cloud sandboxes.
proposed_solution: A secure AI agent platform that plans user tasks, validates execution requests, generates Python programs, executes them inside isolated Celesto sandboxes, records execution history, and cleans up sandboxes after execution.
objectives: Execute tasks inside isolated cloud environments
Track sandbox lifecycle and execution results
